description: This file defines the CookieSigner class for creating signed Amazon CloudFront cookies, including methods for generating signatures and validating URLs.

classes.name: CookieSigner
classes.description: A class for signing cookies for Amazon CloudFront to handle private content access.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the CookieSigner with a key pair ID and private key.

methods.name: getSignedCookie
methods.description: Creates a signed CloudFront cookie using URL, expiration, or a custom policy.

methods.name: validateUrl
methods.description: Validates that the URL has a proper scheme ('http' or 'https').
